description: Micro-Rabat — Colore: Blue-notte & sage Collezione: Micromondo Codice: 5814 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Geometric Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 135 cm Rapporto: 135 cm × 32 cm Toni: Blue The new prints in the Micromondo collection reinterpret three classic Fortuny designs in an entirely new way. At first glance, Micro-Rabat, Micro-Campanelle and Micro-Barberini seem like modern, geometric, small scale patterns, but step back and a large scale Fortuny design magically reveals itself. Printed at the Fortuny factory in Venice. The beauty of Fortuny is that no two runnings are ever the same. Each is a unique piece of art in its own right, with variations in color and texture. When placing a reserve, a dye lot cutting will be provided for review.
